Bug_Title: RANGE: Array length is out of bounds (RANGE_ARRAY_LENGTH)
Bug_Details: Method is called with array parameter and length parameter, but the length is out of bounds. This will result in IndexOutOfBoundsException at runtime.
Bug_Explanation: The code demonstrates an out-of-bounds access by using a length parameter that exceeds the actual size of the array. This results in an IndexOutOfBoundsException at runtime when the loop tries to access elements beyond the array's length.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case 'testShowBugArrayLengthOutOfBounds' calls the method 'showBug' with an array of length 5 and attempts to access 10 elements, which triggers an IndexOutOfBoundsException when the loop in 'showBug' tries to access beyond the array's length.
